title: Register and formality · 语体与正式程度：口语与书面语的语法选择
pattern: Formal: whom / postpone / implementation of  ·  Informal: who / put off / implement
summary: 同一个意思在正式书面语和口语中常有不同的语法和词汇选择：whom、拉丁词源动词、名词化结构都是正式语体的标志。
explanation: 英语的语体大致分为口语、日常书面语和正式语体。C2 水平的学习者要能根据场合选择合适的语法形式。例如“你把信寄给了谁”，口语可以说 Who did you send the letter to?，正式书面语则应写作 To whom did you send the letter?，其中 whom 作介词宾语，不能省略。
**短语动词与拉丁词源动词**是另一组重要对比。put off、go on with、find out 等短语动词多用于口语，而 postpone、continue、ascertain 更常见于正式文件：The board decided to postpone the meeting.（董事会决定推迟会议。）中文学生常把“推迟”直译成 put off，在正式信函中会显得不够得体。

**名词化结构**（nominal style）是书面语的典型特点：The implementation of the new policy caused confusion. 比 When they implemented the new policy, people were confused. 更简洁、更客观。名词化的代价是句子变长、动作感变弱，因此写作时要在“正式”与“清晰”之间取得平衡。
**缩略形式**（can't、I'm、won't）在日常对话和非正式邮件中很自然，但在正式信函、报告和学术论文中通常写全形式：I am unable to attend the conference. 同样，split infinitive（分裂不定式，如 to clearly define）在现代英语中已被广泛接受，但在最严格的正式文本中仍有人避免，可以根据读者选择。
语体选择没有绝对的对错，关键是读者与场合。写给上司、客户或机构的正式信件，应避免口语化结构；写给朋友的邮件则不需要过于拘谨。学会在两种风格之间切换，是 C2 水平的重要标志。
mistakes: ✗ The report was written by who? → ✓ By whom was the report written? 正式书面语中，介词后的疑问代词要用 whom。

✗ I can't attend the meeting, so I will put off the decision until we know more. → ✓ I am unable to attend the meeting, so I will postpone the decision until we have more information. 正式场合应避免缩略形式和口语化的短语动词，改用 unable、postpone 等词。
✗ The committee have investigate the matter. → ✓ The committee has investigated the matter. committee 作为整体使用时通常视为单数，且 investigate 要用过去分词 investigated 构成现在完成时。

examples.text: To whom should I address this application?
examples.note: whom 用于介词之后，是正式用法。

examples.text: I would be grateful if you could forward the documents at your earliest convenience.
examples.translation: 如您能尽快转交这些文件，我将不胜感激。

examples.text: The board has decided to terminate the agreement.
examples.translation: 董事会已决定终止这项协议。
examples.note: terminate 比 end 更正式。

examples.text: The implementation of the new policy caused considerable confusion.
examples.translation: 新政策的实施造成了相当大的混乱。
examples.note: 名词化结构，是书面语的典型特点。

examples.text: I am unable to attend the conference, as I will be abroad.
examples.translation: 我无法出席会议，因为我将在国外。
examples.note: 正式场合不用缩略形式。

examples.text: The committee will investigate the matter thoroughly.
examples.translation: 委员会将彻底调查此事。
examples.note: investigate 替代口语中的 find out about。

examples.text: It is essential to clearly define the scope of the study.
examples.translation: 明确界定研究范围至关重要。
examples.note: 分裂不定式 to clearly define，现代英语中可以接受。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的形式（正式书面语）。
exercises.translation: 这份报告是由谁撰写的？
exercises.explanation: 介词 by 之后的疑问代词用 whom，正式书面语中尤其如此。

exercises.prompt: 选择正确的词语（正式用语）。
exercises.sentence: The board decided to ___ the meeting until next year.
exercises.translation: 董事会决定将会议推迟到明年。
exercises.explanation: postpone 是“推迟”的正式说法；put up with 意为“忍受”，go on with 意为“继续”，come up with 意为“想出”，都不符合语境。

exercises.sentence: The ___ of the new policy has caused confusion.
exercises.translation: 新政策的实施引起了混乱。
exercises.explanation: 正式书面语常用名词化结构 the implementation of…，implement 是动词，不能直接放在 the 之后。

exercises.source: 委员会将彻底调查此事。
options: The committee will investigates the matter thoroughly.
The committee will investigate the matter thoroughly.
The committee will investigation the matter thoroughly.
The committee will investigating the matter thoroughly.
exercises.explanation: will 之后接动词原形 investigate。investigation 是名词，investigating 与 investigates 形式都不对。

exercises.source: 如您能尽快转交这些文件，我将不胜感激。
options: I would grateful if you could forward the documents as soon as possible.
I would be grateful if you could forwards the documents as soon as possible.
I would be grateful if you could forward the documents as soon as possible.
I would be grateful if you could to forward the documents as soon as possible.
exercises.explanation: be grateful 的结构要完整，could 后接动词原形 forward，不能加 to 或 -s。

options: By whom was the decision made?
The implementation of the reforms was delayed.
The committee have investigate the matter.
exercises.explanation: investigate 应改为过去分词 investigated 构成现在完成时，committee 作为整体视为单数，应写作 The committee has investigated the matter.

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 如有任何疑问，请随时与我们联系。
exercises.explanation: do not hesitate to + 动词原形，是正式书信中常见的礼貌表达。

exercises.prompt: 把单词排成正确的句子。
exercises.translation: 明确界定研究范围至关重要。
exercises.explanation: 副词 clearly 插在 to 与动词之间，即分裂不定式，在现代正式英语中可以接受。
